title: Live voice
subtitle: Talk with your Agent while work continues
profileHint: Voice and work models are independent. Saving never records, starts a model, or changes the text conversation.
chooseModel: Choose a verified voice model and a transport supported by this endpoint.
steeringPolicyHint: This setting controls corrections only for voice-started tasks. Existing text tasks retain their safe boundaries; tool and approval permissions remain unchanged.

steeringPolicyDescription.safe_boundary: Apply corrections at the current step's safe boundary.
steeringPolicyDescription.supersede_model_step: Explicitly allow a voice-started task's current model step to be interrupted for a correction. Tools already running retain their original lifecycle.

profileRequired: Save a voice profile for this conversation first.
noVerifiedModel: No verified duplex model is available for this device.
probeConnectionHint: Tests this saved profile's model connection, handshake and cleanup only. Opens no microphone and does not verify capture, playback or latency experience.
probeRtcUnavailable: A WebRTC connection test needs an actual device offer. This button does not change your saved transport.
probeVerified: Model connection and cleanup confirmed. Device voice experience still needs actual testing.
probeUnconfirmed: Model connection is unconfirmed. Check the profile or permissions.
probeCleanupUnconfirmed: Model connection confirmed, but cleanup is unconfirmed.
nativeModuleRequired: This installation does not include the native audio module. Use a development or production build that includes it.
desktopUnsupported: This Desktop does not provide an available voice service. Text conversations can continue.
transportUnavailable: This device does not support the saved voice transport. Configure an alternative explicitly.
consent: Only this click requests microphone access and starts live voice.
relayRecoveryWanted: Connection recovery has stopped capture. Capture continues only after server confirmation; you can choose to keep it paused.
relayRecoveryPaused: Connection recovery keeps the microphone paused. Reconnecting will not open it automatically.
emptyCaptions: Captions appear as you talk. Draft captions and backchannels never start work.
sourceRevoked: The earlier spoken text was withdrawn. Audio consumption facts remain; its text is no longer displayed.
audioTiming: About {{seconds}} s of audio consumed · {{precision}}. This does not mean the whole sentence was heard.
workTargetUnknown: No exact original work target has been observed.
sourceContextHint: This utterance's timing cannot reliably identify the current task. Check its text and exact target. Confirmation links only this utterance; it grants no tool or approval permission and does not mean the correction has been applied.
sourceContextNoTask: No running task can currently be confirmed
sourceContextMissing: The complete source text for this revision is no longer visible. State your intent again.
sourceContextObserver: Observers cannot confirm. Check and click on the endpoint holding this voice session.
confirmSourceContext: Confirm this utterance targets the current task
approvalHint: Existing permissions and the specific question apply. Open the original conversation for click-only approval. A simple yes never grants authority.
backgroundPolicy: Backgrounding, lock, calls, or device changes stop capture and playback. Desktop work continues. Returning never opens the microphone automatically.
reportedEchoOn: Echo processing is reported enabled. Actual quality depends on the device.
reportedEchoOff: Echo processing is not enabled. Headphones are recommended.
secureConnectionRequired: This browser requires a secure connection and available audio device APIs to start voice.
